scope: Targeted static published build/CLI/MCP registration and mixed implementations; core task/subtask/dependency/next/status/start paths, newer FileOperations/FileStorage and legacy JSON lock/save, selected create/AI expansion/dependency/note writers; client API/Supabase update/retry/watch boundaries; TDD workflow state/transitions/commit/finalize/abort/activity and sequential agent loop/result parsing; extension activation/board/cache/optimistic status paths and selected test assertions. Not every-line, full provider/prompt/OAuth/MFA/credential/RLS/external-server/all-import-export-move-remove/all-extension/security/browser/runtime/scaling certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Tag-specific highest-ID-plus-one allocated from an earlier collection read, optional provider work, then legacy save; AI expansion reads before provider call and replaces updated collection later. Newer tag save locks/reloads outer structure but replaces supplied task array; no transactional allocation or operation key.
lifecycle_review.select: Core and legacy selectors build completed-dependency sets, prefer eligible subtasks of in-progress parents, then priority/dependency-count/ID main tasks; pending and in-progress candidates allowed. Dependency add checks self/missing/cyclic references on pre-save snapshot. Selection unreserved and checks not shared across all mutation paths.
lifecycle_review.claim: Start snapshot conflict check allows same target and sibling work under in-progress parent, supports force/no-status-update and tolerates status persistence failure before preparing CLI child command. No exclusive ownership, lease, current-owner predicate, execution ID or worker capacity reservation.
lifecycle_review.progress: Mutable task details/test strategy/metadata, timestamped notes, local workflow context/events and loop progress. File status/update load entire tag before save lock; legacy and proper-lockfile directory protocols differ at same lock path. No expected revision/attempt fencing; mixed same-tag/full-file stale snapshots can overwrite changes.
lifecycle_review.review: TDD state machine enforces phases; RED zero reported failures auto-completes internal subtask, GREEN requires zero failures. MCP counts supplied by caller, standalone stricter validator not installed by inspected production service. Public status path bypasses TaskEntity.canComplete. No qualified reviewer/artifact/evidence/accepted-child gate.
lifecycle_review.complete: Main FileStorage status can set done without child acceptance; subtask updates auto-adjust parent. MCP commit stages/commits Git before workflow advancement. Finalize requires clean tree, persists COMPLETE, calls status updater that catches errors, then deletes state; task/workflow/Git/log effects can diverge.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Cancelled/blocked are record statuses. Workflow abort marks in-memory aborted/persists then removes state, without worker stop/rollback. Loop stop changes in-memory flag after current iteration; sync execution has no per-work timeout, verbose child not signaled by stop. CLI start forwards signals but no durable attempt authority.
lifecycle_review.recover: Home-directory workflow JSON keyed by sanitized project path, Steno save, load/resume and backup helpers; no cross-process workflow CAS or multi-host session authority. JSONL append/log errors best effort. Local watcher/brief-filtered realtime callback expose changes/errors without durable replay. API retry repeats thrown operations, update client has no expected revision, backend RLS/claims unknown. Loop completion text markers precede nonzero exit and iteration counts do not verify task transitions.

external_sources.method: Read primary pinned dependency source through web tool to distinguish default .lock directory/mkdir/rmdir/mtime renewal from candidate legacy regular-file create/unlink lock. No dependency installed or executed; static interoperability boundary, not a reproduced runtime race.
